title: My alarm went off for a wake-up I never set ⏰
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:52 in the morning my phone alarm went off for a wake-up I never set.

scenes.narration: At 3:52 in the morning my phone alarm went off for a wake-up I never set.
The label on the screen said, get up, he is leaving. I live with my brother. His door was shut and his light was off.
I pressed snooze. Ten seconds later it rang again, and the label had changed. Get up now, he is at the door.
I walked down the hall in my socks. His bedroom door was open a hand's width, and the bed inside was made. Perfectly flat. Like nobody had slept in it for days.
But I had heard him cough through the wall every night that week. I was sure of it. I counted the coughs, one for each night.
My phone buzzed in my hand. The alarm label said, do not look at the front door.
I looked. The chain was off. The door stood open, and the corridor light outside was glowing, even though our building turns it off at midnight.
My phone rang once more. The label read, thank you for waking me. I have been in your brother's bed all week. I am the one who coughs.
So tell me. Do you run out of the door, or lock yourself in the bathroom?

overlays.text: RUN OUT  or  LOCK THE BATHROOM
